reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering forage, moss items, cinema access, legendary fish, minerals, fossils, a restorative drink, tree seeds, and mussels were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established cross-asset fish and glossary names, gameplay effects, invitation semantics, object gender, biological terminology, and status naming; both found no remaining objective issue.

Morel_Description.source: Sought after for its unique nutty flavor.
Morel_Description.translation: Este căutat pentru aroma sa aparte, asemănătoare nucilor.

Moss_Description.source: A special type of plant that grows in shady areas.
Moss_Description.translation: Un tip deosebit de plantă care crește în locuri umbroase.

MossSoup_Description.source: It's thick and slimy, but edible.
MossSoup_Description.translation: Este groasă și vâscoasă, dar comestibilă.

MossySeed_Description.source: This can be planted to grow rare wild trees.
MossySeed_Description.translation: Poate fi plantată pentru a crește copaci sălbatici rari.

MovieTicket_Description.source: Admits one to the movie theater. Giving this to a friend invites them to the movies with you.
MovieTicket_Description.translation: Permite accesul unei persoane la cinematograf. Dacă îl dăruiești unui prieten, îl inviți să vadă un film cu tine.

MsAngler_Description.source: Uses a bioluminescent dangler to attract prey.
MsAngler_Description.translation: Folosește o momeală bioluminescentă pentru a atrage prada.

Mudstone_Description.source: A fine-grained rock made from ancient clay or mud.
Mudstone_Description.translation: O rocă fină, formată din argilă sau noroi străvechi.

MummifiedBat_Description.source: The delicate wings have been perfectly preserved.

MummifiedFrog_Description.source: This ancient frog may have lived in the jungle canopy.
MummifiedFrog_Description.translation: Este posibil ca această broască străveche să fi trăit în coronamentul junglei.

MuscleRemedy_Description.source: When you've pushed your body too hard, drink this to remove 'Exhaustion'.
MuscleRemedy_Description.translation: Când ți-ai solicitat prea mult corpul, bea acest remediu pentru a elimina „Epuizarea”.

MushroomTreeSeed_Description.source: Place this on your farm to plant a mushroom tree.
MushroomTreeSeed_Description.translation: Pune-o în fermă pentru a planta un copac-ciupercă.

Mussel_Description.source: A common bivalve that often lives in clusters.
Mussel_Description.translation: O moluscă bivalvă comună, care trăiește adesea în colonii.
